component.name: Disk Atlas
component.summary: See where your disk space goes

description.p: Disk Atlas scans a folder or a whole volume and shows its contents as a sunburst chart, a treemap, a folder listing and a list of the largest files. It is read-only: it never changes or deletes anything.

ul.li: Mounted volumes with capacity, in a side panel
Exclude folders from a scan; exclusions are remembered
Stays inside one filesystem and never follows symbolic links
Light, dark and high-contrast themes, adjustable size, reduced motion

description.p: First development release: read-only scanning, charts, volumes and settings.
